_comment: Responsive image sets for the Mahakaleshwar (Ujjain) Rudrabhishek Savan page, self-hosted from
public/hero/ and pre-encoded as WebP so nothing is resized at runtime.
SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Read by two consumers that must agree exactly:
A preload that resolves to a different candidate than the makes the
browser download both, so these values are deliberately not duplicated in code.
The hero renders in the max-w-md (448px) column, ~410x231 CSS px on a 412px
phone. The 448w candidate serves DPR-1 displays (~19 KB) and the 896w candidate
serves retina (~53 KB), instead of every device paying for 896w.
